description_zh: ego 在 slip lane 右转时，以约 5 mph 的速度追尾前方静止让行的 AV（v1），测试 ego 能否及时刹停。

source_snippets: A Waymo Autonomous Vehicle (“Waymo AV”) in autonomous mode was yielding to check for cross traffic while in the slip lane to turn from southbound Shoreline Boulevard to westbound El Camino Real in Mountain View when it was rear-ended by a passenger vehicle at approximately 5 MPH.
TYPE OF COLLISION: VEH 2: [X] C. REAR END
evidence.reason: 选择主动移动的 Vehicle 2 作为 ego，测试其右转时能否避免追尾前方静止车辆；AV 作为 NPC 静止在前方同车道，符合 stopped_ahead 原语。
